Message:
Phase 80: settings with a schema, versions and safe writes

The settings file now carries a version and migrates from files written
before (a masked copy is kept as .v1.bak). The fields the app relies on
are type checked with zod; others pass through. Writes are atomic
(temporary file and rename) and read once into memory. A broken file is
kept beside it and defaults are used. A field named like a key, token,
secret or password is refused on save and removed on load, with a line
in the local log.

Author: Claude
Message:
Add Outlook mail in the app's own interface

Microsoft Graph behind a native screen: folders, the list with unread and
attachment marks, search, the message, reply, reply all, archive, delete, mark
unread and compose. Sign-in is Microsoft's own page (OAuth with PKCE, a public
client registered by the person); tokens live in the vault and are used only in
the main process. An email's HTML shows in a sandboxed frame without scripts,
forms or frames, with remote images (tracking pixels) off until allowed, and its
links open in the browser. The shared OAuth helper can now redirect to localhost,
which is what Microsoft's portal registers.
